definition: reaching for feminine-coded signals on my own account, with nobody else in the room

settled:
I reach for feminine-coded behaviours, aesthetics and signals as safety-raisers for myself, independent of anyone's presence. The mechanism is the same as when the signal comes from another person, the absence of macho cues and the presence of attunement, applied from the inside.

The environmental form needs a woman in the room. This form I run myself, which is what makes it a lever I control.

It asks nothing of a felt sense. The signal is observable, and the response lands on the settling side of the dial, so it is one of the levers that works around what I cannot picture or decode.

Singing along to a chosen female voice is the worked case: a warm feminine vocal says you are safe here, repeated, until the alarm lies down far enough to let the expression out.

That was the historical pull toward feminine things. It was never wanting to be female. It was my nervous system reaching for the strongest all-clear it had.
